author: Johnneylee Jack Rollins
name: XivPrism
description: A paired, read-only standalone companion HUD for player, target, party, Wayfinder guidance and Piano now playing. Layout profiles stay on the receiving device. Native Moonlight composition and device-specific apps remain separate milestones.
pending: Use the explicit development package; hardware-specific and controller acceptance remain separate.
verification: The plugin loaded in the running Wine game and served its paired viewer over the private tailnet. Actual game data rendered in desktop and phone-size Chromium viewports. Tests also cover stale hiding, revocation, parser bounds and local layout export. Specific glasses, native device shells and Moonlight composition remain unverified.
